title: Octagons of the Qaytbay madrasa floor (Cairo)
subtitle: Qaytbay madrasa, Cairo

construction.note: The finished design was read from Brian Wichmann’s W2 drawing, its corners snapped to exact values. We devised the construction; the drawing gives no steps.
construction.changes: The compass steps, their order and the named points are ours. The comparison with the drawing checks the finished lines, not how the design was first laid out.

credits.source: Tiling Search, data202/W2: mosaic floor, Qaytbay madrasa
credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: The design was read from his drawing; the construction is ours. He also lists it at the Qalawun complex in Cairo, the Friday mosque of Yazd and in James Wild’s Cairo sketchbook (V&A E.3839:170-1938).

given.O: The centre of a large octagon.
given.A: A corner of that octagon, where it touches the next one.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.
Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D.
Draw the line through O that halves the angle AOB. Draw the line through O that halves the angle BOC. They cross the circle at E, F, G and H.
Join A, E, B, F, C, G, D and H with straight lines. This makes the octagon.

Draw a vertical line through A. Draw a vertical line through C. Draw a horizontal line through B. Draw a horizontal line through D. The four lines make a square with corners K1, K2, K3 and K4. Join them to mark the tile that repeats.
Draw a straight line through B and E. It crosses the vertical line through A at R. Draw a straight line through A and E. It crosses the horizontal line through B at T.
Turn the lines through R and T round O by 90°, three times. This copies them to K2, K3 and K4.

ink.text: Ink the large octagon. Ink the two sides of the small octagon at each corner of the tile.

parts.text: Ink the large octagon: from A through E, B and on round, back to A.
Ink from R to E and from E to T. These are two sides of the small octagon at K1.
Ink the same two lines at K2, K3 and K4.

pattern.text: Put copies of the square tile side by side. The large octagons touch at their corners. A small octagon sits where four tiles touch, with a dart on each side of it.

expect.note: Large octagon 2√2, small octagon 6√2 − 8, dart 3 − 2√2, cell 4.
